profile_text.body:
Glean is a for-profit enterprise AI company founded in 2019 and headquartered in Palo Alto, California. The company describes itself as an enterprise AI platform connected to an organization's data, designed to help employees find information, create content, and automate work. Its platform emphasizes security, explainability, and permission-aware retrieval, and the company positions these properties as prerequisites for AI to function effectively in enterprise environments.

Glean's primary product is an enterprise knowledge search and assistant platform that the company says supports more than 100 connectors and includes data access governance. It has been adopted across organizations including Booking.com, Ericsson, GCash, and Zillow, which the company quotes as reporting an 80% adoption rate. Use cases described on the site include company-wide search, AI agent building in natural language, compliance-friendly data access, and centralized intranet functionality.

The held facts show that Glean has 139 legal matters associated with California, though no specific cases are detailed. The company also has a presence in the MCP server registry through a listing called co.gleanit/gleanit, which supports search, reading, and writing of highlights, notes, screenshots, collections, projects, and tags within a tool called Gleanit.
